en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws was asked and I was present, about the woman who sees the yellowness. So heasws said: ‘Whatever was before the menstruation (Haydh), so it is from the menstruation (Haydh), and whatever was after the menstruation (Haydh), so it is not from it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked, when I was in his presence, about the case of a woman who experiences a discharge of yellowish color. He (the Imam) said, ‘What is before Hayd (menses) is of Hayd (menses) and what is after Hayd (menses) is not Hayd (menses).”’
